fees.note: City of Grayville recreation page: 'Campsites are $20.00 per night' (15 water/electric sites).
Florence County Parks: 'Sites are $25.00 per night.' Camping allowed year-round; water off mid-October to early May.

Vernon County 2024 rate sheet (the one the park page links): rustic $20, electric and water $40, full hookup $45 a night; a week is 7 nights for the price of 6; $7 reservation fee. Advance reservations need 2 nights.
Jackson County terms and conditions 2025: camping $20 per unit per night, $10 advance reservation fee; no daily vehicle fee.

Pulaski County Park 2025 rate sheet: Prime 50-amp sites $37 Sun-Wed and $42 Thu-Sat in peak season (Mar 28 - Sep 22), $32 / $35 off-season; the two Prime Plus sites with a shelter $50-60; weekly $225. Senior, veteran and AAA discounts. Two-night minimum (three on holiday weekends).

source: https://pcparkky.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/2025-rates-v3.pdf (Pulaski County Park Rate Sheet for 2025; read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: River's End 2026 rates, full-hookup RV sites: standard $57 low season, $72 mid, $90 peak; preferred $65 / $80 / $103; holidays and events $98 / $111. Weekly rates; 28+ night discounts in winter.
City of Escondido Dixon Lake fees (effective 2024-09-15): full-hookup campsite $60 a night, tent-only $35, $5 reservation fee, $5 extra vehicle, $1 per dog.

Nickerson Beach rate card (2026 site): water and electric $39, full hookup $47 a night with a Nassau County Leisure Pass; non-residents $64 / $72. Seven-night minimum Memorial Day - Labor Day; dump $9; 4% card surcharge.
Dutchess County park fee schedule: Wilcox RV sites 1-10 $30 a night for county residents, $35 non-residents; tent sites $20 / $30. Book online or by phone; no walk-ins.
Chautauqua County Fair non-fair camping contract 2026: Central Ave. electric and water $25, electric and water $30, electric, water and sewer $35, 50-amp full hookup $45 a night, plus card fees.
Loup Power District: 'Electrical hook-ups and primitive camping available during the summer at no charge.' No reservations; 7 days per month limit in the Loup Park system.
City of Miller listing (last assured 2026-06-04): 'Free will donation for three days. After 3 days, a daily fee of $30.00.' First come, first served.
Edson Lions Park Campground: C$35 a night plus tax for 15/30/50-amp sites, C$25 approved tent sites, C$210 a week; C$3 booking fee. Book online or by phone; mid-April to Oct 31.
City of Kewaunee 2026 marina fee schedule: transient water/electric sites $40 a day ($36 a day by the week, $550 a month), tax included.
Santa Barbara County fee schedule (fees as of 2023-01-04): basic sites $40 Apr-Sep, $35 Oct-Mar; electric sites $55 / $50; beachfront premium $55 year-round; $10 reservation fee; $15 extra vehicle.
City of Flora 2024 camping fees: travel trailers and campers $20 a day, $120 a week; no reservations, pay in advance.
City of Alma campground brochure: $20.00 per night for the paved electric sites.

Port of Grays Harbor rates: RV sites $54.68 a night plus tax ($62 total), $59.09 plus tax ($67) on Fridays and Saturdays Memorial Day - Labor Day; weekly $395, monthly $785 with tax; tent $35; dump $10. 10% senior discount.
City of Paris parks department: 'Campsite Fees: $20.00 per night/$100 per week (14 days limit stay)'.
City of Stroud lake page (fees updated 2023): camping with electric $20 a day, primitive $10; seniors 55+, active military and disabled $15. First come, first served; 14-day limit.
Beaver RV Park rates page: water and electric $40, full hookup $50 a night plus tax; primitive tent $20. Books online (Staylist), by phone or text; season March 1 - November 30.
Glasgow Parks and Recreation booking pages: riverfront and riverview RV sites (50 amp, water; upper level with sewer) from $35 a night; primitive from $20.
City of Pauls Valley Checkfront booking, quote for Tue 20 Oct 2026: Longmire RV sites from $28 a night, primitive campsites $12; $5 booking fee per site per night is kept on cancellations.
Fremont County page: 'Fees are 16.00 per day for electric sites and 11.00 per day for tent camping.' Drive-in self-pay; 8 RV sites with 50-amp electric.
Delaware County Conservation's 2026 season notice (KMCH, 2026-04-28): water/electric sites $25 a night, water-only $20, primitive $15; first come, first served with self-registration.
